title: BlazeVGGT: 13x Faster VGGT at 2,000 Frames via Camera Token without Training

problem.summary: Feed-forward visual geometry models, exemplified by VGGT, have demonstrated strong multi-view reconstruction capabilities through dense global attention.
statements: Feed-forward visual geometry models, exemplified by VGGT, have demonstrated strong multi-view reconstruction capabilities through dense global attention.

However, the resulting all-to-all cross-view computation scales quadratically with the number of input views, making long-sequence inference particularly expensive due to substantial frame-level redundancy among highly overlapping observations.

We uncover a topologyfirst, geometry-later evolution in VGGT camera tokens: shallowlayer tokens reliably capture local view neighborhoods, whereas deeper-layer tokens progressively encode globally organized inter-view geometry.

solution.summary: BlazeVGGT exploits the progressively emerging interview structure of VGGT camera tokens to reduce redundant cross-view computation.

components: As illustrated in Fig. 3, our framework consists of two simple steps.
First, we construct a view-level similarity kernel from camera tokens and select a compact set of mutually complementary views using a determinantal objective.
Second, we retain all input frames as Queries while restricting the KV context of global attention to the selected views.
